rationale: Surge rose 1.0x -> 1.4x and the rider was notified in-app before pickup with the new multiplier, the revised fare and the free-cancel option ("Fares are 1.4× higher right now. Your new estimated fare is $17.29. You can cancel for free.", SURGE-1); the rider rode -> the higher fare applies, no refund (SURGE-2). A fraud flag raises the bar to 95% (TH-3). The outcome rests on reading the notice text; a lone reading gives 87%. Settled by agreement (both sides read it the same way) -> no_action; otherwise a person decides.
